question: ________ are things a firm owns.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Assets** 

 
 
• Assets are resources owned by an individual or business expected to provide future **economic benefits**.
 
• **They can be classified as**:
 
 
• **Current Assets**: Convertible into cash within one year (e.g., cash, inventory).
